title: DeCash
tagline: DeCash is social payments protocol with fast, low-cost transfers. We aim to adopt non-crypto natives by introducing account abstraction for easier account management and a polished product to ensure a seamless and intuitive user experience.

prizes.placement: Best use of Blockscout Block Explorer

description:
DeCash is a protocol that brings fast and simple decentralized social payments to everyone.

In today's blockchain landscape, moving assets across various networks is a cumbersome and costly process. Users encounter high fees, slow transaction times, and fragmented liquidity, which collectively hinder a seamless user experience. These barriers prevent many people from fully embracing blockchain technology.

Our product offers a seamless protocol for decentralized social payments, enabling users to transfer assets quickly and efficiently across multiple blockchain networks. Leveraging cutting-edge innovations in blockchain interoperability and transaction processing, DeCash delivers a superior user experience.
how_its_made: We utilize the Polygon AggLayer to bridge assets, ensuring smooth and cost-effective transfers across different blockchain networks. Additionally, our payment solution through links provides an easy and accessible way for anyone to use the app via account abstraction with Dynamic. To enhance user engagement, we have implemented the Chronicle Oracle to set price targets, creating a gamified experience.
